scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ade/client build && pnpm --filter @ade/cli build && node scripts/dev-desktop.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ade/client build && pnpm --filter @ade/cli build && pnpm --filter @ade/desktop build
scripts.build:backend: node scripts/cargo.mjs build --locked -p ade-daemon -p ade-runtime --features ade-runtime/native-terminal --bins
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ade/client typecheck && pnpm --filter @ade/terminal typecheck && pnpm --filter @ade/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @ade/desktop typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:backend && pnpm build && playwright test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm deadcode && pnpm test:e2e
